# Refined Default

Refined Default keeps the familiar default Obsidian layout while adjusting spacing, typography and colours. The stated aim is better readability and visual hierarchy without departing from the core default feel.

![Refined Default screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/faisaltamanojr/Refined-Default/HEAD/banner.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Refined Default"
    author: "faisaltamanojr"
    repo:   "faisaltamanojr/Refined-Default"
    slug:   "refined-default"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/refined-default"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/faisaltamanojr/Refined-Default"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/faisaltamanojr/Refined-Default/HEAD/banner.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a refined take on the default Obsidian look with cleaner spacing, improved typography, and subtle color tweaks. Preserve the familiar layout while improving readability and visual hierarchy. Keep the core default feel while smoothing UI details for a calmer workspace."
}
```
